name: Forecast demand per item and location
outcome: A demand forecast at the item and location level, refreshed every planning cycle, that the supply and inventory plans are built from.
description: The comparative test, whether the forecast beats the naive baseline and the method it replaced, is a measure and lives in measures. It is how a forecast is judged, not what the job is: no vendor markets a forecast as beating a naive baseline, so an outcome that requires that sentence can only ever be filled by a measured result, and the cell reads empty where the capability plainly exists. A solution claims this job by producing the forecast; the evidence decides whether it is a good one.
